newsitem.title: USA: NuCo2 Inc buys Convenience Carbonation.
newsitem.headline: NuCo2 Inc buys Convenience Carbonation.

text.p: NuCo2 Inc said Friday that it has agreed to acquire the customer lists and bulk CO2 assets of privatelyu-held Convenience Carbonation, a carbon dioxide distributor based in Pueblo, Colorado.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

The company said that the deal will add about 300 accounts to its customer base, and provide service to customer rental accounts and refill service to customer owned systems. NuCo2 said it will begin servicing these accounts on July 15.
NuCo2 supplies bulk CO2 systems and liquid carbon dioxide to retail establishments for fountain beverages.
